positions.name: ZypherionAdoptionAnnouncement
positions.frame: what decision is being made about the analytics database, on what grounds, and on what timeline?
positions.why: Quinton performs the adoption decision (src-1), backs it with a quantified performance claim (src-2), and commits to a timeline (src-3) — three moves of a single decision-announcement arc, all present/future-realis and concrete. Xena's bulleted summary (src-4) restates the same three facts — database, performance, timeline — under the same content-level question, though it performs differently: where src-1/src-2/src-3 argue and commit in real time, src-4 records the decision as already settled in a compressed technical digest. That shift in how it's carried (argued vs. logged) is held as tension within the same frame rather than resolved.
